from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter
roots=[Path('app'),Path('core'),Path('feature')]
files=[]
for root in roots:
    if root.exists():
        files.extend(p for p in root.rglob('*.kt') if 'build' not in p.parts)
print('KOTLIN_FILE_COUNT='+str(len(files)))
# Simple independent structural metrics; intentionally heuristic, not a Kotlin parser.
rows=[]
for p in files:
    text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    lines=text.splitlines()
    fn=sum(1 for l in lines if l.lstrip().startswith('fun ') or ' fun ' in l)
    classes=sum(1 for l in lines if any(tok in l for tok in (' class ',' data class ',' object ',' interface ',' sealed class ',' sealed interface ')))
    suppress=text.count('@Suppress')
    rows.append((len(lines),fn,classes,suppress,str(p)))
print('TOP_STRUCTURAL_FILES')
for loc,fn,cl,sup,p in sorted(rows, reverse=True)[:25]:
    print(f'{loc:5d} LOC | {fn:3d} fun | {cl:3d} types | {sup:2d} suppress | {p}')
# Detekt baseline inventory: these are accepted/suppressed issues and therefore debt visibility.
ids=Counter(); total=0; baseline_files=[]
for p in Path('.').rglob('detekt-baseline.xml'):
    if 'build' in p.parts: continue
    baseline_files.append(p)
    try:
        root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
    except Exception as e:
        print('BASELINE_PARSE_ERROR',p,e); continue
    for el in root.iter():
        if el.tag.endswith('ID') and el.text:
            rule=el.text.split(':',1)[0]
            ids[rule]+=1; total+=1
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_FILES='+str(len(baseline_files)))
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_ENTRIES='+str(total))
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_TOP_RULES')
for k,v in ids.most_common(20): print(f'{k}={v}')
